messages:
maria: Hey design team — we need a small battalion of assets for next week's launch and linked webinar. Goal: clear benchmark visuals that show Redwood's cost/latency win + social templates for the launch sequence. Quick list below, can you confirm what’s feasible by Wed EOD? :spiral_calendar:

maria: Deliverables (priority order):
- 3 benchmark single-image graphics (desktop hero + 2 social sizes) showing cost per 1M tokens vs two competitors (bar + annotation).
- 1 explainer diagram: routing/caching -> how Redwood saves tokens (simple flow diagram, max 3 panels).
- Webinar slide template (16:9) + thumbnail lockup for YouTube/LinkedIn.
- Social carousel (4 cards) summarizing benchmark highlights + CTA.
- 2 brand-compliant hero variants (light/dark) for homepage and email header.

maria: Constraints: brand font = Inter, color palette = #111827, #0066FF, #10B981, white. Keep iconography minimal. Use the official Redwood logo (SVG) and include small line: "benchmarks run on 8xA100 equiv." small footnote.

leo: Got it. Rough ETA check: benchmark images + diagram by Tue morning, carousel + webinar template by Wed EOD? We can do light/dark hero variants as quick color swaps. Any legal copy review needed for competitor names?

maria: Good q — avoid naming competitor product names explicitly in images; use anonymized labels (Competitor A/B) and a hover/caption on the blog that includes the comparison methodology. Legal is okay with anonymized visual.

anuj: For the benchmark bars, do you want raw $/1M tokens or normalized per-1000 tokens with callouts?

maria: Raw $/1M tokens is primary. Add a small secondary axis or microcopy with normalized values for accessibility. Make the primary number big and bold.

sam: Pixel specs request: 1200x628 for LinkedIn single image, 1080x1080 for IG/Twitter cards, 1920x1080 for webinar slides. Carousel cards should be 1080x1080. Export variants @2x for retina.

leo: Adding deliverable checklist in Figma. I’ll create frames named: "BM-hero-desktop", "BM-social-1080", "BM-social-1200", "BM-diagram-3panel", "Webinar-template", "Carousel-1..4". Sharing link once initial comps ready. Anyone want to drop exact headline copy here?

maria: Headline options (pick 1):
A) "Lower inference cost. Same quality."
B) "Production-grade inference that cuts per-token spend."
C) "Redwood: Serve more for less."

jess: Leaning A for social, C for homepage hero. For webinar thumbnail: "See how we cut inference cost by up to Xx — live demo + benchmarks" (we'll finalize X after final run).

anuj: Small ask on the explainer diagram: can we include an icon set for caching, routing, GPU pools? I’ll attach a simple sprite sheet. We should keep it mono-line to match brand.

leo: Perfect. @brand-bot can you confirm any updated brand dos/don’ts for benchmark claims and color contrast?

brand-bot: Brand checklist: 1) Use primary palette for CTAs (#0066FF). 2) Accent green (#10B981) only for positive delta callouts. 3) Do not use competitor logos. 4) Minimum contrast ratio 4.5:1 for body text. 5) Include small "Data methodology" link on the blog page. Link: https://redwood.example/brand-guidelines

sam: Also note: We’ll need a version of the carousel optimized for ads (headline text area preserved top 20%). Please leave a title-safe margin of 120px at top for 1080x1080 frames.

maria: Budget note — creative ops can allocate 6 designer hours for initial comps, additional hours TBD for iterations. If anything looks like it needs >3 rounds, flag early.

leo: Cool. Plan: mockups in Figma by tomorrow 11am, first export pass Tue 4pm, final assets Wed 3pm. I'll post the Figma link in this thread when frames exist.

maria: Thanks — one more thing: add subtle watermark on slide template footer: "Redwood Inference — Benchmark Series" small, left-aligned.

anuj: Quick colors code block for reference:
```
--primary: #0066FF
--bg-dark: #111827
--accent: #10B981
```

leo: Noted. Will prototype with both headline A & C in the hero comps so we can A/B in early socials.

jess: If we need copy support, I can draft short CTAs and alt text for accessibility.

maria: Amazing — thanks team. Please drop Figma link and any blockers here. If anyone needs the raw benchmark CSV, ping me and I’ll upload to the campaign folder. :sparkles:

leo: Placeholder Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/ABCDEFG/redwood-benchmark-launch (will update frames tonight).

sam: Added task in Asana for distribution + ad variants.

brand-bot: Reminder: submit final hero variants to brand review for archival.

leo: Will do. Closing loop — will post first pass in ~14 hours.

maria: Perfect. Leaving this in your hands, thanks! :rocket:
